image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) positioned against a textured red coral background. The fish displays its characteristic bi-color pattern with a black anterior body and head, and a bright yellow posterior body and tail. The face appears greenish-yellow due to lighting/reflection, and the mouth is slightly open.

The eyes are prominent, large relative to the head size, and clearly visible.

The anal fin is visible and structurally consistent with the dorsal fin.
The caudal fin (tail) is rounded, matching the species description.
